name: oc-ai-report
description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period - AI-metrics JSON records (backend/frontend/QA) grouped by developer domain; per-area Architect estimate (custom fields) and Dev-lead estimate (ticket field / sum of child sub-task estimates); ticket type; bug counts and hours-logged-on-bugs per area; total development time (logged + bug hours) plus logged hours per user & ticket via the Tempo API (fallback Jira worklogs); two time gains (Architect and Dev-lead, each without/with bug hours; a gain shows as '-' when meaningless: placeholder estimate <=0.5h, no logged time, or magnitude beyond +/-1000%); sections ordered Totals -> Summary -> Detail; the Detail-per-user table also shows each ticket's Jira status and a Final flag (terminal status for the ticket type) and highlights AI Contrib below 60% in red (in both the Summary-by-user and Detail-per-user tables). The HTML is split into five tabs (All by default, User Stories, US-final only, Bugs-final only, and every other ticket type), each holding the full filtered report; Totals-by-area and Detail-per-user expand into per-month groups, while Summary-by-user expands per user into a month-by-month breakdown (grouping keyed on the record's date). The hours-on-child-bugs column is labelled Sub-bug h. Prints Markdown and writes a full-width self-contained styled, date-stamped HTML file plus a CSV to ./docs/ai-usage-report-<date>.{html,csv}. Reads Jira (Atlassian MCP) + optional Tempo (TEMPO_API_TOKEN).
